## Overview

This standalone R program creates dates of first and last evaluations from embedded source-logical data. It doubles the original sample or record count, writes the simulated analysis data to Excel, and produces clinical RTF and PDF deliverables.

## Analysis Steps

1. Reconstruct the source-like analysis records and replace subject identifiers with PILOT identifiers.
2. Generate a reproducible simulated dataset with twice the original sample or record count while retaining the relevant treatment and analysis relationships.
3. Apply the population, parameter, visit, and treatment conditions defined in the program.
4. Convert SAS dates to ISO dates and list first/last evaluation dates and protocol version by site.
5. Arrange the display data in the required clinical format and generate the Excel, RTF, and PDF outputs.

## ADaM Data and Main Variables

The program uses **ADSL**.

| Variable | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `USUBJID` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |
| `TRT01P` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |
| `TRT01PN` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |
| `SITEID` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |
| `SITENAM` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |
| `AMENDNO` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |
| `RFICDT` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |
| `RFPENDT` | Main analysis or reporting variable used by the program |

The displayed results use the treatment groups, analysis population, denominators, and category definitions implemented in the accompanying R program.
